verdict.rationale: Column's own docs say it can send and receive international transfers over SWIFT via its API, receives full raw data for international wires, and claims access to over 150 global currencies. The pack has no evidence on FX rate transparency or a documented per-currency or per-corridor coverage map. Missing for 10: documented FX rates or rate transparency, an explicit list or map of supported currencies and corridors, independent or hands-on corroboration of international wires.
